svg.title: Example of one country's NTD programme: what each system sends to the ICR and what it gets back.
svg.text: EXAMPLE · DATA IN AND OUT OF THE ICR IN ONE COUNTRY'S NTD PROGRAMME
data going out of the ICR, or between tools

g.text: DHIS2 sends org units and routine data. Sightsavers' Metabase sends data
Crosscut takes locations, populations and indicators from the ICR. Its catchment areas
and hard-to-reach communities go back into the location registry.
Other programmes' tools, ICF and DIGIT for malaria, get the same locations, populations
and indicators. ICF also gets Crosscut's catchments.
CommCare sends delivery data to Crosscut and Metabase, and campaign data and
supervision coverage to the ICR. ICF and DIGIT send their campaign data too.
The next round starts from what the ICR holds: locations, catchments, populations
and past results are already there.
